description_target.target_text: Detect all rooms that contain a red(2) seed. For each one, collect the wall cells touching that chamber’s interior and mark those boundary wall cells with cyan(8) on an otherwise background grid.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))

    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (wall? v) (member? v (list 1 7 9)))
    (define (make-room id cells)
      (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
             (r (first bb)) (c (second bb))
             (h (+ 1 (- (third bb) r))) (w (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) c))))
        (list id cells (list r c h w))))
    (define (room-id room) (first room))
    (define (room-cells room) (second room))
    (define (room-bbox room) (third room))
    (define (room-r room) (first (room-bbox room)))
    (define (room-c room) (second (room-bbox room)))
    (define (room-h room) (third (room-bbox room)))
    (define (room-w room) (fourth (room-bbox room)))
    (define (room-center room)
      (list (+ (room-r room) (quotient (room-h room) 2))
            (+ (room-c room) (quotient (room-w room) 2))))
    (define (room-order rooms)
      (sort (map room-id rooms)
            (lambda (a b)
              (let ((ra (list-ref rooms a)) (rb (list-ref rooms b)))
                (if (= (room-r ra) (room-r rb))
                    (< (room-c ra) (room-c rb))
                    (< (room-r ra) (room-r rb)))))))
    (define (extract-room-data grid)
      (define seen (make-hash))
      (define cell-to-rid (make-hash))
      (define rooms (list))
      (for* ([r (in-range (rows grid))] [c (in-range (cols grid))])
        (when (and (not (wall? (at grid r c))) (not (hash-has-key? seen (list r c))))
          (define cells (connected-region grid r c (lambda (rr cc v) (not (wall? v))) 4))
          (define id (length rooms))
          (for ([p (in-list cells)])
            (hash-set! seen p #t)
            (hash-set! cell-to-rid p id))
          (set! rooms (append rooms (list (make-room id cells))))))
      (list rooms cell-to-rid))
    (define (room-graph grid)
      (let* ((data (extract-room-data grid))
             (rooms (first data))
             (cell-to-rid (second data))
             (adj (make-hash)))
        (for ([room (in-list rooms)]) (hash-set! adj (room-id room) (list)))
        (define (add-edge a b)
          (hash-set! adj a (sort (remove-duplicates (cons b (hash-ref adj a (list)))) <))
          (hash-set! adj b (sort (remove-duplicates (cons a (hash-ref adj b (list)))) <)))
        (for* ([r (in-range (rows grid))] [c (in-range (cols grid))])
          (when (= (at grid r c) 7)
            (define ids
              (remove-duplicates
               (filter number?
                       (map (lambda (d) (hash-ref cell-to-rid (list (+ r (first d)) (+ c (second d))) #f))
                            cardinal-deltas))))
            (for* ([a (in-list ids)] [col (in-list ids)])
              (when (< a col) (add-edge a col)))))
        (list rooms adj cell-to-rid)))
    (define (walls-grid grid)
      (grid-from-fn (rows grid) (cols grid)
        (lambda (r c) (if (wall? (at grid r c)) (at grid r c) 0))))
    (define (paint-room out room color)
      (paint-cells out (room-cells room) color))
    (define (room-has-color? grid room color)
      (not (eq? (find-first (lambda (p) (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) color)) (room-cells room)) #f)))
    (define (room-colors grid room)
      (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0)))
                                 (map (lambda (p) (at grid (first p) (second p))) (room-cells room)))))
    (define (wall-boundary-cells room grid)
      (remove-duplicates
       (filter (lambda (p) (and (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows grid) (cols grid))
                                (member? (at grid (first p) (second p)) (list 1 7))))
               (flatmap (lambda (p)
                          (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d))))
                               cardinal-deltas))
                        (room-cells room)))))
    (define (strip-mark n idxs [color 8])
      (grid-from-fn 1 n (lambda (r c) (if (member? c idxs) color 0))))
    (define (distances adj start)
      (define queue (list start))
      (define dist (make-hash))
      (hash-set! dist start 0)
      (define (search)
        (unless (empty? queue)
          (define cur (first queue))
          (set! queue (rest queue))
          (for ([n (in-list (hash-ref adj cur (list)))])
            (when (not (hash-has-key? dist n))
              (hash-set! dist n (+ (hash-ref dist cur) 1))
              (set! queue (append queue (list n)))))
          (search)))
      (search)
      dist)
    (define (graph-path adj start goal)
      (define queue (list start))
      (define prev (make-hash))
      (hash-set! prev start #f)
      (define (search)
        (unless (or (empty? queue) (hash-has-key? prev goal))
          (define cur (first queue))
          (set! queue (rest queue))
          (for ([n (in-list (hash-ref adj cur (list)))])
            (when (not (hash-has-key? prev n))
              (hash-set! prev n cur)
              (set! queue (append queue (list n)))))
          (search)))
      (search)
      (if (not (hash-has-key? prev goal))
          (list)
          (let rebuild ([cur goal] [acc (list)])
            (if (eq? cur #f) acc (rebuild (hash-ref prev cur #f) (cons cur acc))))))
    (define (articulation-points adj)
      (define nodes (sort (hash-keys adj) <))
      (filter
       (lambda (rem)
         (let ((others (filter (lambda (n) (not (= n rem))) nodes)))
           (if (<= (length others) 1)
               #f
               (let ((seen (make-hash)) (queue (list (first others))))
                 (define (search)
                   (unless (empty? queue)
                     (define cur (first queue))
                     (set! queue (rest queue))
                     (for ([n (in-list (hash-ref adj cur (list)))])
                       (when (and (not (= n rem)) (not (hash-has-key? seen n)))
                         (hash-set! seen n #t)
                         (set! queue (append queue (list n)))))
                     (search)))
                 (hash-set! seen (first others) #t)
                 (search)
                 (not (= (length (hash-keys seen)) (length others)))))))
       nodes))
    (define (crop-room grid room)
      (subgrid grid (room-r room) (room-c room)
               (+ (room-r room) (room-h room) -1)
               (+ (room-c room) (room-w room) -1)))
    (define (motif-key grid room [with-values #f])
      (format "~a"
              (sort
               (filter values
                       (map (lambda (p)
                              (let ((v (at grid (first p) (second p))))
                                (if (= v 0)
                                    #f
                                    (if with-values
                                        (list (- (first p) (room-r room)) (- (second p) (room-c room)) v)
                                        (list (- (first p) (room-r room)) (- (second p) (room-c room)))))))
                            (room-cells room)))
               cell<)))
    (define (motif6-key grid room)
      (format "~a"
              (sort
               (filter values
                       (map (lambda (p)
                              (if (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 6)
                                  (list (- (first p) (room-r room)) (- (second p) (room-c room)))
                                  #f))
                            (room-cells room)))
               cell<)))
    (define (dihedral-cell-variants cells)
      (if (empty? cells)
          (list (list))
          (remove-duplicates
           (for/list ([t (in-range 8)])
             (let* ((raw (map (lambda (p)
                                (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
                                  (cond [(= t 0) (list r c)]
                                        [(= t 1) (list c (- r))]
                                        [(= t 2) (list (- r) (- c))]
                                        [(= t 3) (list (- c) r)]
                                        [(= t 4) (list r (- c))]
                                        [(= t 5) (list (- c) (- r))]
                                        [(= t 6) (list (- r) c)]
                                        [else (list c r)])))
                              cells))
                    (minr (apply min (map first raw)))
                    (minc (apply min (map second raw))))
               (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) minr) (- (second p) minc))) raw) cell<))))))
    (define (motif-dihedral-set grid room)
      (let ((cells (filter values
                           (map (lambda (p)
                                  (if (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0)
                                      #f
                                      (list (- (first p) (room-r room)) (- (second p) (room-c room)))))
                                (room-cells room)))))
        (dihedral-cell-variants cells)))
    (define (dominant-fill-excluding-6 grid room)
      (let* ((vals (map (lambda (p) (at grid (first p) (second p))) (room-cells room)))
             (colors (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 6)))) vals))))
        (if (empty? colors)
            #f
            (let* ((entries (map (lambda (color) (list (count-where (lambda (v) (= v color)) vals) color)) colors))
                   (best (first (sort entries (lambda (a b) (if (= (first a) (first b)) (> (second a) (second b)) (> (first a) (first b))))))))
              (if (> (first best) (quotient (length (room-cells room)) 2)) (second best) #f)))))
    (define (room-signature grid adj room)
      (list (length (room-cells room))
            (length (hash-ref adj (room-id room)))
            (count-where (lambda (p) (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 2)) (room-cells room))
            (count-where (lambda (p) (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 3)) (room-cells room))))

    (let* ((rg (room-graph g))
           (rooms (first rg))
           (cells (remove-duplicates
                   (flatmap (lambda (room) (if (room-has-color? g room 2) (wall-boundary-cells room g) (list))) rooms))))
      (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) cells 8))
  ))
